the right questions.

coaching.hero.intro.value: Whether you're navigating a difficult career moment or trying to build a team that actually functions well - coaching works best when it's grounded in real experience. That's what Altogether Agile brings.
coaching.hero.intro.label: Hero introduction
coaching.hero.intro.hint: The teal hero at the top

coaching.approach.label.label: Approach eyebrow
coaching.approach.label.hint: The approach section, on pale teal

coaching.approach.heading.label: Approach heading
coaching.approach.heading.hint: The approach section, on pale teal

coaching.approach.p1.value: Most people who come to coaching are not short of information. They know what they should probably do. What they need is space to think it through - without someone else's agenda in the room.
coaching.approach.p1.label: Approach, first paragraph
coaching.approach.p1.hint: The approach section, on pale teal

coaching.approach.p2.value: My role as a coach is to hold that space and ask the questions that help you find your own answers. That might sound simple. In practice it requires real skill - and real discipline not to reach for the easy answer on your behalf.
coaching.approach.p2.label: Approach, second paragraph
coaching.approach.p2.hint: The approach section, on pale teal

coaching.approach.p3.value: Where it's useful, I'll bring 25 years of agile and organisational experience into the room. But the work is yours. That's why it sticks.
coaching.approach.p3.label: Approach, third paragraph
coaching.approach.p3.hint: The approach section, on pale teal

coaching.service.1.label.label: Service 1 tag
coaching.service.1.label.hint: Service 1: the one-to-one block. The word before "Coaching" in the pill

coaching.service.1.tagline.value: Space to think. Clarity to act.
coaching.service.1.tagline.label: Service 1 tagline

coaching.service.1.description.value: One-to-one coaching for professionals navigating change - whether that's a new role, a difficult team dynamic, a career pivot, or the challenge of leading in an agile organisation without a map.
coaching.service.1.description.label: Service 1 description

coaching.service.1.detail.value: This isn't mentoring or consultancy. I won't tell you what to do. My role is to hold the right space and ask the questions that help you find your own answers - because those are the ones that actually stick.
coaching.service.1.detail.label: Service 1 detail

coaching.service.1.includes.value:
60-minute sessions via video call or in person (London)
Pre-session reflection prompts sent 48 hours before
Session notes and agreed actions within 24 hours
WhatsApp or email support between sessions
ICF-aligned approach throughout
coaching.service.1.includes.label: Service 1 what is included
coaching.service.1.includes.hint: Service 1: the one-to-one block. One per line, add or remove lines freely

coaching.service.1.packageNote.value: Pricing discussed during your free chemistry session
coaching.service.1.packageNote.label: Service 1 price note

coaching.service.2.label.label: Service 2 tag
coaching.service.2.label.hint: Service 2: the team block. The word before "Coaching" in the pill

coaching.service.2.tagline.value: Better teams don't happen by accident.
coaching.service.2.tagline.label: Service 2 tagline

coaching.service.2.description.value: Coaching for agile teams that are technically running the events but not getting the results - or for newly formed teams that want to build good habits from the start.
coaching.service.2.description.label: Service 2 description

coaching.service.2.detail.value: I work with the whole team, not just the Scrum Master or team lead. That means coaching the dynamics, not just the process - how the team makes decisions, how they handle conflict, and whether their retrospectives are actually changing anything.
coaching.service.2.detail.label: Service 2 detail

coaching.service.2.includes.value:
Initial team assessment and health check
Fortnightly team coaching sessions (90 minutes)
One-to-one sessions with team lead or Scrum Master
Retrospective facilitation and coaching
Management 3.0 practices woven throughout
